advisory.body: This is a translation for your convenience. Only the German version of this legal notice is legally binding. Show the German version
imp.h.responsible: Responsible for content pursuant to § 18(2) MStV
imp.h.dsa: Point of contact under the Digital Services Act

imp.adr: We are neither willing nor obliged to take part in dispute resolution proceedings before a consumer arbitration board (§ 36 VSBG).
imp.liab: We are responsible for our own content on these pages under general law. For third-party information that we merely transmit or store (for example, community posts in the app), the liability rules of Art. 4 to 6 of Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 (Digital Services Act) apply. There is no general obligation to monitor such information (Art. 8 DSA). As soon as we become aware of illegal content, we remove it without delay.
imp.links: Our service contains links to external third-party websites whose content we have no influence over. The respective provider or operator is always responsible for the content of linked pages. If we become aware of any legal violations, we will remove the links concerned without delay.
